user_rulings.ruling: Main street bends right/east from the market and terminates at the dragon-statue bridge, not straight to the shrine hill.
Farmland on the east side is correct.
Village channels were untidy; make them regular and aligned.
Western residential zone sat too far north; move it south.

The main street runs unbroken from the south grand torii to the dragon-statue bridge; buildings and market line both sides of it. West of it: residential plus small channel branches. East of it: farmland and the main river. The north shrine is reached by a small lane out of the commercial belt, or by looping round to the back and climbing.
